description: Everything about the prospective run that was fixed in advance. The six items the protocol names as changes that would not be minor deviations appear here as machine-checkable fields, so that the commitment survives without an institution to enforce it.

enforcement.statement: If any field below differs from the corresponding field of a run manifest, the seal is broken for that run. The run is then reported as a deviation and is not presented as pre-registered.
enforcement.note: Under in-principle acceptance this was 'we will consult the recommender'. That sentence has no force outside the venue that supplied the recommender, so it is replaced by a condition a script can evaluate.

thresholds.note: The eleven constants recorded in the completed run's verdict.json. None is changed for the prospective run and none is added to.

control.role: Re-run of the reference model, so that the backend version change is not read as a family effect. Evaluated first; gates the primary arm.

primary.think_note: The model has no native thinking regime. The pilot established that the harness's disabled-think request is accepted; acceptance is not behavioural inertness, and no claim rests on it.
primary.role: Cross-family replication in a natively non-thinking model.

environment.zone_bias_note: The environment pins a bias probability, but the read-out is taken before any bias is applied, so the estimand does not depend on it.

completed_run_reference.note: The completed run is the baseline the control arm is compared against. Its tv_bar fixes the centre of the R5 tolerance band as a pre-declared constant. It is reported, not re-analysed.

not_minor_deviations: substituting a different model for either arm
changing any of the eleven threshold values

manifest_field_map.note: How each not-minor-deviation item is located in a run manifest, so the comparison is mechanical rather than a matter of reading.
